Callers at main_0166.c:42708 and 42867 invoke it in separate paths; the mode values are not independently identified as semantic modes. The fields' meanings and resulting policy/status are not established by the available evidence, so no semantic name is proposed.

Inspected the complete body in decompiled/main/main_0055.c:30651-30885. Callers at main_0055.c:17259 and 30304 consume that result; the associated candidate criteria are not resolved. No source-level operation is proposed.
